Table B-10 is reproduced from NCHRP 117 and is shown as Exhibit "14". It is to be noted that table 11, Page 30, and Table B-5, Page 70, contained in NCHRP 117 (Recommended Design Criteria) are not the same as the Design Noise Level values listed as standards in PPM 90-2.
It is recognized that the proposed improvement of Lincoln Highway will have a design year (1990) noise impact. The predicted design year exterior L10 noise levels for forty-six (46) of the forty-nine (49) sites designated Land Use Category "C" of PPM 90-2 and twenty-six (26) of the twenty-eight (28, sites designated Land Use Category "B" of PPM 90-2 are higher than the design year L10 noise level standards contained in PPM 90-2 for the respective Land Use Categories. In addition, the predicted interior traffic generated design year L10 noise levels for ten (10) of the twenty-eight (28) sites designated Land Use Category "E" of PPM 90-2 are higher than the design year interior L10 noise level standard of 55 dBA contained in PPM 90-2.
A supplemental noise report is available with the Design Report for the improvement of Lincoln Highway between Chicago Road to Cicero Avenue. The Design Report and Noise Report are available through and accessible at the District Office of Transportation, 300 N. State Street, Chicago Ill. 60610; and the Central Office of the Illinois Department of Transportation, Administration Building, 2300 S. Dirksen Parkway, Springfield, Ill. 62764. Exception to the noise level standards will be requested for all developed land-uses adjacent to the improvement in conjunction with the design approval request.
